name: kickoff
description: Kick off a new project with one standard questionnaire: questions branch on earlier answers, each offers pre-defined options and a default, answers are recorded in the project, and a charter (overview, goal, scope, numbered decisions with their reasons, open questions) is generated from them. A question with a real trade-off — when backward compatibility starts to apply — is always asked explicitly, never settled by accepting defaults. It then scaffolds the project: the docs/ skeleton, a small instructions-only CLAUDE.md, and the task config and a workflow whose steps check INVEST, SOLID and DRY (in the repo, or outside it for a client project). A machine-wide dev-port registry, shared by every Claude account on the Mac and aware of ports already published in compose files, hands each project a free port, and your own defaults, kept per Claude account, override the questionnaire's. On an existing project it proposes answers from what the project already holds, with evidence, and shows edited files as a diff instead of overwriting them. Runtime-free (bash + awk).
